create_distributed_index: create a DistributedIndex to initialize embeddings and doc maps for passage retrieval
search_knn_distributed: search k-nearest neighbours using inner product metric across distributed GPU embeddings
save_load_index: save and load sharded embeddings and passages across distributed workers to disk
create_faiss_gpu_index: create a GPU FAISS index with IVFFlat, IVFPQ, IVFSQ, or FlatIP index types
train_faiss_index: train a FAISS GPU index on passage embeddings using the gpu_index_factory method
